svg.title: Figure 3. Imperfect columns and the Southwell plot
svg.desc: Two panels in nondimensional form. (a) Load ratio P over P_cr against the mid-length deflection divided by the imperfection. A column with an initial bow delta_0 follows alpha over (1 minus alpha), and a column with a load offset e follows the secant result (Eq. 10.31); both rise steeply at first and then flatten, approaching P over P_cr = 1 without reaching it. The perfect column stays straight up to P_cr and then deflects at constant load (dashed). (b) The same bowed-column readings plotted as deflection over load against deflection fall on a straight line whose slope is 1 over P_cr and whose intercept is delta_0 over P_cr, so P_cr and the equivalent bow follow from readings taken well below the critical load.
